Branch: mick/diffusion-parallel-conv-halo-in-place, stacked on #46149 (93ccc5dc4f), commit 56c7668c91

## Motivation

Under spatial-parallel VAE decode, `SpatialParallelCausalConv3d` builds each conv input in three full passes over the activation:

1. `torch.cat` of the temporal feature cache.
2. `F.pad` for the width and time padding, plus its zero fill.
3. `halo_exchange`'s `torch.concat` of the neighbours' halo rows.

The single-GPU `WanCausalConv3d` already builds the same input in one channels_last pass (`cat_pad_channels_last_3d`), but the parallel conv had no route to it. The fused NCDHW cat-pad also needs a contiguous input, so channels_last activations fell back to the aten ops.

Profiled 189-frame Cosmos3-Nano decode on 4xB300 (rank 0), out of 1.45 s of GPU busy time:

| op | GPU time |
|---|---|
| halo concat | 134 ms |
| cat/pad fallback (copies, zero fill, cache cat) | 193 ms |

## Modifications

- `layers/parallel_conv.py`:
  - `SpatialParallelCausalConv3d.forward` handles the common case in one pass: a height-preserving conv with channels_last_3d weights, a "zeros" height pad, a matching cache, and no ROCm conv hook. One `cat_pad_channels_last_3d` writes the cache frames, the shard, the width/time padding and zero halo rows.
  - The new `fill_halo_rows_` then exchanges the shard's edge rows with the adjacent ranks, using the same P2P pairs as `halo_exchange`, and copies the received rows into the halo rows in place. The global top and bottom halos stay zero.
  - Every other case keeps the existing path.
- `test_vae_spatial_parallel_decode.py::test_halo_rows_filled_in_place_match_the_concatenated_halo`: two gloo ranks with uneven shards check that `fill_halo_rows_` gives bitwise the tensor `halo_exchange` concatenates. The test uses NCDHW tensors because gloo only sends default-contiguous ones; the channels_last path runs on GPUs and is covered by the md5 checks below.

## Accuracy Tests

Values only move, so outputs are bitwise unchanged.

Cosmos3-Nano T2V 720p 189 frames, 4xB300. The base is "Run Cosmos3's multi-GPU VAE decode on the lossless fast path", which gives a channels_last spatial-parallel decode. Videos are saved at x264 crf 0, two requests per build, and the MP4 md5 is identical in both quality tiers:

| | `quality="exact"` | default (`lossless`) |
|---|---|---|
| base | 9afb4b6195 / a35e3c5382 | 65c152eb33 / d49d169d91 |
| this PR | 9afb4b6195 / a35e3c5382 | |
| this PR + the epilogue follow-up | 9afb4b6195 / a35e3c5382 | 65c152eb33 / d49d169d91 |

The default-crf MP4s are identical too (7d5582dbad / 2f9d13baba).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Cosmos3-Nano T2V 720p 189 frames, 4xB300, synchronized stage timers, two requests per build. The decode stage includes the MP4 encode streamed during the decode ("Encode Cosmos3 video while it decodes").

| | decode stage | client e2e |
|---|---|---|
| base | 1.266 / 1.286 s | 22.631 / 22.638 s |
| this PR | 1.124 / 1.137 s | 22.463 / 22.461 s |
| this PR + the epilogue follow-up | 1.117 / 1.224 s | 22.469 / 22.522 s |

The passes removed here are the ones profiled on the base (rank 0): the 134 ms halo concatenation and the 193 ms of unfused cat/pad. The decode was not re-profiled with this change.

Wan2.2 multi-GPU decodes run the same parallel conv on channels_last weights since #46149, so they take this path too (not measured here).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -403,6 +405,63 @@ def halo_exchange(
     )
 
 
+def fill_halo_rows_(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    height_halo_size: int,
+    recv_top_buf: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    recv_bottom_buf: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    parallel_group: GroupCoordinator | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """fill x's zero halo rows with the adjacent ranks' edge rows, in place
+
+    x carries ``height_halo_size`` rows above and below this rank's shard; the
+    global top and bottom halos stay zero, as ``halo_exchange`` pads them
+    """
+    halo = height_halo_size
+    parallel_group = parallel_group or get_decode_parallel_group_coordinator()
+    rank = parallel_group.rank_in_group
+    world_size = parallel_group.world_size
+    group = parallel_group.device_group
+    group_ranks = parallel_group.ranks
+
+    top_rows = x[..., halo : 2 * halo, :]
+    bottom_rows = x[..., -2 * halo : -halo, :]
+    recv_top_buf = _ensure_recv_buf(recv_top_buf, top_rows)
+    recv_bottom_buf = _ensure_recv_buf(recv_bottom_buf, bottom_rows)
+    memory_format = _halo_memory_format(top_rows)
+    p2p_ops = []
+    if rank > 0:
+        prev_rank = group_ranks[rank - 1]
+        p2p_ops.append(dist.P2POp(dist.irecv, recv_top_buf, prev_rank, group))
+        p2p_ops.append(
+            dist.P2POp(
+                dist.isend,
+                top_rows.contiguous(memory_format=memory_format),
+                prev_rank,
+                group,
+            )
+        )
+    if rank < world_size - 1:
+        next_rank = group_ranks[rank + 1]
+        p2p_ops.append(
+            dist.P2POp(
+                dist.isend,
+                bottom_rows.contiguous(memory_format=memory_format),
+                next_rank,
+                group,
+            )
+        )
+        p2p_ops.append(dist.P2POp(dist.irecv, recv_bottom_buf, next_rank, group))
+    if p2p_ops:
+        for req in dist.batch_isend_irecv(p2p_ops):
+            req.wait()
+    if rank > 0:
+        x[..., :halo, :].copy_(recv_top_buf)
+    if rank < world_size - 1:
+        x[..., -halo:, :].copy_(recv_bottom_buf)
+    return recv_top_buf, recv_bottom_buf
+
+
 def _make_boundary_halo(
     x: torch.Tensor,
     neighbor: torch.Tensor | None,
@@ -679,11 +738,50 @@ def __init__(
         self.parallel_group = parallel_group
         self.rank, self.world_size = _parallel_rank_and_world_size(parallel_group)
 
+    def _pads_halo_in_place(self, x, cache_x) -> bool:
+        """whether one pass can build the conv input, halo rows included"""
+        return (
+            cat_pad_channels_last_3d is not None
+            and self.height_halo_size > 0
+            and self._halo_conv_forward is None
+            and _conv3d_weight_is_channels_last_3d(self.weight)
+            and current_platform.is_amp_supported()
+            and not torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+            and (
+                cache_x is None
+                or (cache_x.device == x.device and cache_x.dtype == x.dtype)
+            )
+            and _conv_preserves_local_height(
+                height_halo_size=self.height_halo_size,
+                height_pad_top=self.height_pad_top,
+                height_pad_bottom=self.height_pad_bottom,
+                kernel_height=self.kernel_size[-2],
+                dilation_height=self.dilation[-2],
+                stride_height=self.stride[-2],
+            )
+        )
+
     def forward(self, x, cache_x=None):
         padding = list(self._padding)
         if spatial_parallel_decode_disabled():
             padding[2] = self.height_pad_top
             padding[3] = self.height_pad_bottom
+        elif self._pads_halo_in_place(x, cache_x):
+            # one channels_last pass writes the cache frames, the shard and
+            # zero halo rows; the halos then arrive in place, so the input is
+            # never copied again to concatenate them
+            padding[2] = padding[3] = self.height_halo_size
+            x_padded = cat_pad_channels_last_3d(x, cache_x, padding)
+            if x_padded is not None:
+                self._halo_recv_top_buf, self._halo_recv_bottom_buf = fill_halo_rows_(
+                    x_padded,
+                    self.height_halo_size,
+                    self._halo_recv_top_buf,
+                    self._halo_recv_bottom_buf,
+                    self.parallel_group,
+                )
+                return super().forward(x_padded)
+            padding = list(self._padding)
         x = causal_conv3d_cat_pad(x, cache_x, padding)
         x = x if current_platform.is_amp_supported() else x.to(self.weight.dtype)
